From: The Batch <news@deeplearning.test>
Subject: This week: small language models on laptops

Top stories this week. Local AI keeps getting faster: new quantization schemes let 1-billion-parameter models run on ordinary laptops at interactive speed. Researchers released a family of embedding models that support over a hundred languages and Matryoshka truncation. A startup showed an email client that triages messages entirely on-device. In policy news, regulators published guidance on model transparency. Our tutorial of the week explains retrieval-augmented generation step by step, from chunking documents to hybrid search with BM25 and vectors. Finally, a reader asks how to evaluate calibration; we walk through expected calibration error, reliability diagrams and conformal prediction sets with worked examples.
